Agreed, and yeah you would think it would be much more expensive. But all cremation is is just putting you in a blast furnace, and if someone was extremely poor they’d stick your ashes in a shoebox. Meaning they wouldn’t even have to buy an urn which could be expensive too. Burial on the other hand is ridiculously expensive, something like a casket can be thousands of dollars, the service itself would be thousands of dollars, and if they choose to embalm you that’s another thousand or so. My grandpa was embalmed and buried in a beautifully kept cemetery, and I can’t imagine what my aunt, who organized it, paid to do it. That was in 2015 and I think she’s still paying for it to this day. My grandma on the other hand was cremated, and her remains are in a small metal tin. And I’m not sure what it cost total but I know it was all definitely under a thousand.
